primary_deployable_family: best of CTX_MOMENTS, CTX_COV, CTX_PRED, CTX_COMBINED by TRAIN-only nested subject LOSO
threshold: zero native/logistic margin; no OUTER threshold tuning
case_priority: Gate A pass and Oracle minus mean-correction pooled BA < 0.003 -> CASE C
Gate A pass and Gate B failure -> CASE B
Both gates pass and PC augmentation improves generic context pooled BA by >= 0.003 with >= 4 positive folds -> CASE E
Both gates pass otherwise -> CASE F
case_A_note: CASE A is the generic positive label; CASE F is its mutually exclusive no-material-PC-augmentation reporting subtype.
gate_B_shuffled: primary full-context BA strictly exceeds fold-specific 95th percentile of 200 shuffled TRAIN-context mappers in >=4 folds
gate_B_bootstrap: lower 95% subject-paired CI for context-minus-global BA > -0.005
biological_subject_bootstrap: average repeated-fold appearances within subject first; resample unique subjects 20000 times
null_permutation: permute TRAIN context-to-target assignment only; selected hyperparameters and source corrections stay fixed; deterministic seed 0
pc_scope: secondary augmentation of combined descriptor only, never classifier intervention
